text:
maya: dropping a fresh sketch + thinking out loud: what if we keep explicit Models and Datasets labels but group them under a single collapsible container called 'Workspace' with contextual anchors (small chevrons) that reveal deep-linkable crumbs. mock: https://staging.redwood/design/contextual-anchors.png

trent: interesting. My main thing is permalinks — if someone has /models/123 bookmarked it should keep working and when they land the left rail should show context without stealing focus. Breadcrumb should read: Workspace > Models > ModelName.

sam: routing notes: we'll keep canonical routes `/console/w/:org/models/:id` and `/console/w/:org/datasets/:id`. Client-side alias `/console/w/:org/workspace/models/:id` is ok for internal nav. For legacy top-level links we can add server-side 301s: `{ from: '/models/:id', to: '/console/w/:org/models/:id', code: 301 }`. We must preserve query params and hash anchors (e.g., `?panel=metrics#latency`). Also storing UI state in querystring is the right call so deep links reproduce split/panel state.

rachel: accessibility checklist: do NOT steal focus on programmatic expansion when landing via permalink. Announce state changes only for user-initiated toggles via an `aria-live="polite"` region, e.g., "Workspace expanded". Breadcrumb nav should be `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` and last crumb gets `aria-current="page"`. Keyboard: header should be a native button or role=button, support Enter/Space, arrow key navigation inside the group, and ESC to collapse when focus is inside. Add a skiplink to main content.

maya: copy question: 'Workspace' vs 'Assets' vs 'Catalog'. Leaning 'Workspace' because it matches the top-level path and emphasizes context. We'll show inline microcopy on hover: "Contains Models & Datasets". Also propose a one-time banner when we roll: "Models are now grouped under Workspace 1 View or take a quick tour" with CTA "Show me" / "Tour". Track CTA CTR and search fallback rate.

sam: implementation checklist: add server redirects for public shortlinks, implement client aliasing for `/workspace/*` to canonical routes, persist split/panel state in querystring, and emit `route:hydrated` event before running scroll anchors to avoid layout jumps. I'll add a small middleware to preserve query/hash during redirects.

preview-bot: preview: https://staging-console.redwood/preview/contextual-anchors (build 5484) :eyes:

rachel: research note: users expect Models top-level. Recommend a phased rollout: internal alpha, then 10-day staged external with dismissible banner offering the tour. A/B test label (Workspace vs Assets) and measure nav clicks vs search fallbacks. Also include NVDA/VoiceOver checkpoints in the acceptance criteria.

maya: action items:
- @sam: redirects + client alias + route:hydrated event + querystring state persistence.
- @rachel: a11y acceptance criteria + research script for A/B.
- @trent: review mocks for bookmark landing behavior and focus rules.

Target: alpha to staging next Friday. Any blockers? :thumbsup:

trent: no infra blockers. Small copy tweak: banner copy to "Models and Datasets are now under Workspace \u2014 View layout or take a guided tour."

sam: will open PR with redirect table and middleware today.

rachel: will add keyboard test cases and live-region wording to the ticket.

maya: thanks folks, pinning mock and adding notes to the ticket.
